purpose: Waits for a by-hand walk of the guided first conversation on a signed release (begun, paused, picked up, finished, then a teach-me request) and reads the owner's folder and the session's transcript on the target, read-only. Takes the target host as a parameter (SQUIRE_TARGET_HOST, an SSH destination, or RCF_TARGET_URL); without one it skips with the line 'external: needs a target host' and never passes.
title: The guided first conversation on a target Mac

testCases.description: On a signed release the first conversation keeps profile, house style and learning log, pauses and picks up, and teaches when asked
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/first-conversation.test.js::on a signed release, the guided first conversation keeps a profile, a house style and a learning log in the owner's folder, can pause and pick up later, and teaches when asked
